source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's SAT1 campus in San Antonio publishes 9 MW of IT capacity and 110,000 square feet of technical space, making it a small to mid-size facility by current AI standards.

The disclosed capacity places it 14th in Texas and at 1.9% of the state's 475 MW of published data center load. That figure is drawn from only 19 of the 133 mapped Texas facilities that publish power numbers, so the ranking describes the disclosed subset rather than the state's true installed base. Texas trails only California and Virginia in AI-relevant capacity among states with published figures.

The certifications, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FISMA, ISO 27001, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942, point to regulated workloads rather than frontier training. At 9 MW the site cannot host the largest distributed training runs, though it fits inference, smaller teams, or one node of a multi-site deployment. The operator does not disclose backup power, renewable sourcing, or grid connection details, so nothing here speaks to how the facility is powered or how firmly it is connected.
